name: FPP Overlay Effects
author: ravenridgelights-turtle; based on Adam Coulombe’s fpp-WledEffects
description: WLED-style controls for FPP native overlay effects: color wheel, RGB/RGBW support, model/submodel/group selection, presets, and active-effect bubbles with Stop buttons on Status. Built for FPP 10.4 and later.

privacy.summary: Controls native effects on this FPP. Reads local model and pixel-string configuration. No telemetry or third-party services.

sends.to: FPP systems explicitly selected for MultiSync
sends.why: Mirror a look on matching remote model names when MultiSync is enabled

privacy.other: Presets, selections, favorites and effect values are saved in config/plugin.FPP-Overlay-Effects.json on this FPP. Uses the FPP menu hook for Status bubbles; does not patch FPP files or change output configurations.
